edits.anchor: Clock times are time-of-day entity nodes with two-digit minutes (h19m30, h10m00) under :time of a date-entity, never bar
edits.text: Clock times are written HHhMMm with two digits each (19h30m, 10h00m, 23h44m, 00h15m, never h19m30) under :time of a date-entity, never bare values. Weekday and dayperiod values stay source-language words (星期五, 下午, 午夜, 清晨) as concepts of the date-entity, never English; an approximator such as 许 takes the time as :op1.
are a flat top-level `and-91` (op1..opN; plain `and` only for coordinated nouns/modifiers)

edits.anchor: The paired connectives 由于/因为…所以 use `have-cause-91` with ARG1 the effect/result (the 所以 clause) and ARG2 the cause/reaso
edits.text: The connectives 由于/因为…所以 use `have-reason-91` with ARG1 the effect/result (the 所以 clause) and ARG2 the reason, whatever the surface order; chained reasoning is nested per clause, not flattened into one big `and`.
每 is :quant; non-numeric quantifiers (各, 多, 所有, 大部分) are :mod, not :quant

- Frequency 'once per N years' / 每年 is rate-entity-91 (ARG1 1, ARG3 temporal-quantity with :quant/:unit) under :frequency; 每小时 is :frequency, not :mod. A numeral+time unit (12小时) is a temporal-quantity (:quant, :unit) attached by :duration, not a fused concept.
- Temporal delimiters (直至, 起, 内 'within') are reified concepts under :temporal with the time expression/quantity as :op1, and they are the anchors in the document-level temporal relations.
- Event compounds made of a verb morpheme plus its noun argument (水浸, 山泥倾泻) are decomposed into the event (浸-01, 倾泻-01) with the noun as its argument, and get aspect, modal and temporal relations.

- Document-level: an explicit date-entity is related to DCT (DCT :before date) and the event it locates is :contained in it, without a separate DCT relation for that event. Habitual/generic events overlap DCT. For quoted or reported content, the speaker entity (ARG0 of the saying verb or the quoted person node) is the modal source for the embedded events, and the author is :full-affirmative toward that speaker.

suggestions: Clarify with the gold convention whether unframed verbs get -00 (several problems show -00 in gold, while the skill says -01).
Clarify whether aspectual verbs such as 开始 should get their own event node; the gold sometimes treats the complement as the head.
Provide a short reference of time-value formats (HHhMMm) in the guideline tool.
